- [USER] User expressed amazement at Norway's performance in the 1952 Winter Olympics and asked if they continued to dominate in later years.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Norway has continued to be a strong force in winter sports since the 1952 Winter Olympics, consistently placing near the top of the medal table, particularly in cross-country skiing and biathlon. Norway has won the most medals in Winter Olympics history, with a total of 368 medals as of the 2018 Pyeongchang Winter Olympics, including 132 gold medals.
- [USER] User commented on Norway's continued success in winter sports and asked if other countries have come close to matching their medal count and dominance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Other nations have come close to Norway's dominance:

  - Germany has also been a strong competitor, winning a total of 240 medals in the Winter Olympics.
